author: Brenton Kemp
title: Cody Laweryson recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Twins have recalled right-hander Cody Laweryson from Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Laweryson has been recalled to take the roster spot of left-hander Anthony Banda (lat), who was placed on the 15-day injured list on Monday. The right-hander has posted a 5.06 ERA across 14 outings for the Twins this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Anthony Banda (lat) placed on IL, out months
desc: Twins left-hander Anthony Banda (lat) has been placed on the 15-day injured list, and will reportedly be out for months rather than weeks.
impact: Banda departed Sunday's game with left side discomfort, and the injury is reportedly much worse than originally thought. The southpaw is expected to miss months with his lat injury, and it's within reason that his season could be in jeopardy. Right-hander Cody Laweryson has been recalled to take his place on the active roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Smith (foot) in lineup Monday
desc: Cam Smith is in the Astros lineup on Monday against the Tigers.
impact: Smith returns from a one-game absence. He is starting in right field and batting sixth.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Buddy Kennedy activated by Mariners
impact: Kennedy will hold a depth role off the bench with Rob Refsnyder placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rob Refsnyder (knees) placed on IL
desc: The Mariners placed Rob Refsnyder on the injured list.
impact: Refsnyder will miss some time. He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Raley (elbow) not in lineup Monday
desc: Luke Raley remains out of the Mariners lineup on Monday against the Angels.
impact: Raley remains hopeful to avoid a stint on the injured list. He is day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominic Canzone (hamstring) back in lineup Monday
desc: Dominic Canzone is back in the Mariners lineup on Monday against the Angels.
impact: Canzone is expected to play through the injury, but he won't play in the outfield. He is the designated hitter and batting third in Monday's series opener.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Janson Junk (wrist) has X-rays return negative
desc: The X-rays came back negative on Janson Junk's wrist.
impact: Marlins manager Clayton McCullough said Junk will make his next scheduled rehab start, which could come on Friday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brendan Donovan (groin) could begin rehab assignment next week
desc: The Mariners say Brendan Donovan could begin a rehab assignment next week.
impact: Donovan was doing some sprints from first to second base on Monday. He is expected to be re-evaluated next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Koss has locker in clubhouse
desc: Christina Koss has a locker in the Giants clubhouse on Monday.
impact: There could be an official roster move announced before first pitch.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena (leg) not in lineup Monday
desc: Astros manager Joe Espada said that Jeremy Pena is not in the lineup for Monday's game against the Twins due to left leg discomfort.
impact: Pena is expected to be further evaluated. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Luis Robert (back) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Mets outfielder Luis Robert (back) will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday.
impact: Robert has been sidelined since April 30 with lumbar spine disc herniation and had recently been running the bases in the latest progression in his rehab. He has seemingly been cleared to begin a rehab assignment, while his original second-half timetable to return likely being pushed up at this point.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Kevin Alcantara recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs have recalled infielder Kevin Alcantara from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Alcantara will take the active roster spot of Matt Shaw (wrist), who was placed on the injured list on Monday. The 23-year-old has seen just 10 plate appearances for the Cubs this season, but is hitting .273 with 17 home runs, four stolen bases, and a .936 OPS in 55 games for Iowa.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Gavin Hollowell recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Cubs have recalled right-hander Gavin Hollowell from Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Hollowell comes up to replace right-hander Ethan Roberts (forearm), who was placed on the injured list on Monday. The 28-year-old struggled to a 6.23 ERA in four outings with the Cubs so far this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Ethan Roberts (forearm) placed on 15-day IL
desc: The Cubs have placed right-hander Ethan Roberts (forearm) on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Roberts allowed two runs (one earned) on two hits and a walk without recording an out on Saturday against the Brewers and will now spend time on the injured list with a forearm issue. The 28-year-old has posted a 4.21 ERA in 23 appearances for the Cubs this season.
